liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Visions Of Johanna** (3 reviews): Called the high point of the show, played well and with much emotion; Reviewer remembers a very beautiful Visions of Johanna from this show, but little else [8][16][17]
- **Help On The Way** (1 review): Opening Help>Slipknot>Franklin's sequence reviewed as weak; Jerry leaned on repetitive riffs rather than real solos [6]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Jerry's guitar playing came and went here, with some good moments [8]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Second-set Scarlet>Fire transition jam called bogged down and uninspired, with Jerry struggling to find his footing [6]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Reviewer, who attended, enjoyed the drums heard during Fire and calls the sound quality decent [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Visions Of Johanna**: rare: 10 archived performances [18]

## The recordings

- **gd95-02-24.AT.5493.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 167 min; rated 2.77/5 by 13 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the sound is typical of Oakland Coliseum audience tapes, which mostly sound poor to them [12]
- **gd1995-02-24.akg.flaschner.91203.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 169 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1995-02-24.141024.cmc4-mk41.ebel.flac1644**: source not stated; 18 songs; 167 min [3]
- **gd1995-02-24.at4071.seff.4776.shnf**: source not stated; 18 songs; 167 min [4]

## Around the show

- Jerry read lyrics from an easel, on more than just the newer songs, including Visions [9]
- Reviewer saw one show of the run; Garcia seemed off, and the band did not fill the venue [13]
- Reviewer found this Oakland run sloppy overall, with the last night's tune the exception [9]
- Only a 12/27/87 Coliseum audience tape sounded good to this reviewer, unlike other Oakland recordings [12]
- Reviewer contrasts high-energy East Coast shows with mellow West Coast ones, noting Jerry was declining [14]
- Reviewer ranks 2/21/95 Salt Lake City as the best of 1995, with an exceptional recording [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd95-02-24.AT.5493.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jon Seff; source: Audience - AT 4071's [1]. Also: Recorded with an AT 4071 microphone to DAT at 48k; this is a shntool-fixed version of an earlier shn set; Transfer chain: DA-20mkII, Hosa S/PDIF, Delta DiO 2496, Peak for downsampling and normalizing, WAV, then SHN; transferred and seeded by Jon Seff [1]
- **gd1995-02-24.akg.flaschner.91203.flac16**: taped by Dave Flaschner; transferred by Chris Davis; source: AKG 460b/ck61 -> custom pre-amp -> D-7 [2]
- **gd1995-02-24.141024.cmc4-mk41.ebel.flac1644**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac16/44.1 Source Info: FOB Schoeps CMC4 Mk41-> Koch P/S-> Panasonic SV255-> DATTransfer Info: Dat Tape (Panasonic SV-3700)-> Marantz CDR-615-> CD (Late… [3]
- **gd1995-02-24.at4071.seff.4776.shnf**: transferred by Jon Seff; source: AT 4071 > DAT @48k [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Wolfgang's: [Grateful Dead Laminate from Oakland Coliseum Arena, Feb 24, 1995 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/backstage-passes/grateful-dead/laminate/OCA950224-A.html) [19]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Arena - February 25, 1995](https://www.dead.net/show/february-25-1995) [20]
